opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000; in special cases up to £750,000; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations; projects must address one or more of the five priority questions. Not funded: individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools or FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, dissemination-only projects, local charities, non-UK based organisations (except in exceptional cases).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK organisations; applicants from diverse backgrounds encouraged, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK.
